text:
Maya Ellis: quick heads-up — want to draft a 2-minute benchmark blurb for launch posts + a single microchart for the webinar hero. can we align on the narrative and who owns visuals/rtf?
Owen Park: yes. propose we focus on: median latency, 95th percentile tail, and $/1k tokens. simple 2-axis microchart + callout numbers.
Priya Sharma: agree. also include a small note about fallback model behavior (when capacity spikes) so enterprise readers see reliability. short line of copy.
Jonas Lee: I can do visual — prefer 3 small tiles: (1) tokens/sec vs model, (2) tail latency, (3) cost per 1k. which datapoints do you want in the tooltip?
Maya Ellis: tooltip: base scenario (hosted), dedicated baseline, private on-prem example. callouts: "~30% cost reduction with batching" and "95th=120ms" — but only if accurate.
Owen Park: let's not claim exact percentages without backing. propose language: "up to 30%" and include a footnote: "varies by model/seq".
Priya Sharma: for the post copy: short headline + 2-sentence body + CTA to webinar. head: "Latency-first economics: how inference choices change unit cost" body: "We measured end-to-end token cost and tail latency across hosted, dedicated, and private setups. See how batching, quantization, and routing affect real app budgets." CTA: "Join the webinar (date) — live demo + Q&A"
Jonas Lee: nice. I'll mock three size variants: social card (1200x628), blog header, and slide hero. sending drafts by EOD.
Maya Ellis: routing/inbound question — when folks click CTA, where should they land? webinar signup -> nurture track A?
Priya Sharma: Lead routing plan: webinar signups go to HubSpot form -> tag: "bench-webinar" -> sequence: immediate confirm email, 48hr reminder, 1-day-before digest. Segment enterprise signups (email domain) and route to SDR queue.
Owen Park: also add an "interest" hidden field for model type (open vs fine-tuned) so we can route to solutions team.
Maya Ellis: good. do we want a short pre-webinar survey question on pain (latency, cost, reliability)? one-click options.
Priya Sharma: yes 1 question: "Which is your top inference pain?" options: [Latency, Cost, Reliability/Scale, Security/Compliance]. map answers to follow-up content.
launch-bot: Webinar created: "Benchmark Bench: Latency & Cost Inference Playbook" scheduled for 2026-04-14 11:00 PDT. Registrations page: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench
Maya Ellis: perfect. Owen, can you pull the 3 datapoints and a short explainer sentence per tile (2 lines each)?
Owen Park: on it. I'll run quick microbench across curated models (gpt-ish open weights + our quant profiles). will post CSV & a 1-paragraph blurb.
Jonas Lee: small design ask — please give data in normalized per-token units and per-1k tokens for cost tile, and raw ms for latency tiles. makes layout consistent.
Owen Park: will do. sample snippet I'll post: ```model,mode,median_ms,95pct_ms,cost_per_1k
redwood-13b,hosted,35,120,0.85
redwood-13b,dedicated,28,95,0.60
redwood-13b,private,30,110,0.70
```
Priya Sharma: draft social copy for approval: "Shipping LLM features? See how serving choices change your latency and token bill. Join our bench webinar to get prescriptive knobs + live demo. Register: https://redwood.example/webinar-bench :rocket:"
Maya Ellis: love it. two editorial checks: 1) avoid absolute claims, 2) include short methodology note on the landing page (seq length, batch config).
Owen Park: methodology note: seq=512 tokens, batch automation on, KV cache warm, quantization: int8/4-bit where applicable. will include a link to full bench repo.
Priya Sharma: timeline: copy + landing by Tue EOD, design by Wed noon, email flow + forms by Wed EOD, rehearsal Fri.
Jonas Lee: tagging mock v1 with timestamp when done.
Maya Ellis: last ask — what is the single metric we want CTA to emphasize? I'm leaning to "95th latency + $/1k" as the quick takeaway number pair.
Owen Park: agree. that'll resonate with engineering buyers and platform teams.
Priya Sharma: fine. I'll craft the follow-up nurture emails based on the top pain choices.
Maya Ellis: thanks team — we'll reconvene after Owen posts bench CSV. :sparkles:
